t: An open-source, adult-size humanoid robot you can build from published plans.
steps: Download the CAD, BOM, and assembly guide from the K-Scale GitHub repos.
Install K-Sim Gym on your computer and train a walking policy in simulation first.
Study the wiring guide and the power board notes in the docs repo.
Send the parts files to a CNC shop and buy the Robstride actuators separately.
Assemble the frame and wire each limb to the power board, with the e-stop connected.
Set up a Raspberry Pi 5 with Raspberry Pi OS and the K-Bot firmware.
Follow the quickstart to scan all 20 actuators over CAN before any motion.
